OWNER DECISION (Ankit 2026-08-03): the guest-funnel roster comes from HubSpot — (1) contacts carrying the podcast pipeline property, (2) referral metadata, (3) meeting-link conversions. HubSpot is the system of record for people and touches. Live facts discovered today, build EXACTLY against them: 45 contacts have contact property podcast_status (enumeration: nominated, outreach-sent, responded, followup-sent, prep-booked, prep-done, recording-booked, recorded, in-production, publish-queued, published, promo-sent, complete, declined, stalled). Companion properties: podcast_invite_source (string: manual|referral|prospecting), podcast_referral_from (referrer display name), recent_conversion_event_name (e.g. 'Meetings Link: ankit98/podcast-prep' = prep call booked; 'Meetings Link: ankit98/podcast-interview' = recording booked; treat any value containing 'podcast-prep' as prep booking evidence and 'podcast-interview' as recording booking evidence).

BUILD scripts/hubspot_roster.py — module + CLI:
1. fetch --out <path> [--api-cmd JSON-array]: retrieves all contacts with podcast_status via HubSpot CRM v3 search API (POST /crm/v3/objects/contacts/search, filter HAS_PROPERTY podcast_status, properties [firstname,lastname,email,podcast_status,podcast_invite_source,podcast_referral_from,recent_conversion_event_name], paginate via 'after' until exhausted, limit 100/page). The HTTP call happens ONLY through a subprocess command template so tests can fake it: default api-cmd is ['python3', str(repo_scripts/'secret_exec.py'), '--secret-env', 'HUBSPOT_API_KEY=mybcat/integrations/api-keys/hubspot', '--', 'python3', str(repo_scripts/'hubspot_roster.py'), '_do_fetch'] — i.e. the CLI re-invokes ITSELF under secret_exec for the privileged leg; the inner _do_fetch subcommand reads HUBSPOT_API_KEY from env, calls the API with urllib (Authorization: Bearer), and prints the raw page JSON stream to stdout. --api-cmd overrides the outer command for tests (a fixture script emitting canned pages). NEVER print, log, or write the key; exclude Authorization from any error text.
2. Output roster JSON {"schema": "hubspot-roster/v1", "fetched_at": iso8601 UTC, "people": [{"name": 'First Last', "email": str|null, "hs_id": str, "stage_hubspot": podcast_status value, "invite_source": str|null, "referral_from": str|null, "prep_booked_evidence": bool, "recording_booked_evidence": bool}]}. Skip contacts whose email is test@example.com or name contains 'Test User'. Atomic write.
3. Failure behavior: on any error, if a previous roster file exists at --out, KEEP it and print a degraded note including its age in hours; exit 0 with {"degraded": reason} on stdout. Exit nonzero only when no roster (fresh or cached) is available at all.

EXTEND scripts/funnel_evidence.py (surgical, keep every existing behavior and test green):

The roster's people join the known-people index (names + emails) alongside the existing CANDIDATE-INBOX/FUNNEL-LEDGER rosters. Referral enrichment: when a roster person has referral_from, carry it into the evidence so nudge/outreach focus items for that person include 'referred by <name>' in the reason.
5. NEW drift dimension 'hubspot_stage_mismatch': map stage_hubspot -> ledger stage vocabulary (document the mapping in the module docstring: nominated->new_inbound, outreach-sent->outreach_sent, responded/followup-sent->in_conversation, prep-booked->prep_call_booked, prep-done->prep_call_done, recording-booked->recorded? NO — recording-booked->recording_booked, recorded/in-production/publish-queued->recorded, published/promo-sent/complete->published, declined->declined, stalled->dormant). For each person present in BOTH roster and ledger where mapped stages differ, record {person, ledger_stage, hubspot_stage} in the focus receipt under hubspot_stage_mismatches and add the count to FOCUS-LIST.json as "hubspot_stage_mismatch": N.
